root_cause_hypothesis: The invoice was processed before the business user confirmed delivery and posted the Goods Receipt Note (GRN). This is a common timing issue for new invoices, preventing the system from completing the three-way match.
recommended_action: Contact the PO owner or business requestor to confirm receipt of goods/services and request they create the GRN in the system.
communication_draft:
Dear HP Enterprise Inc. Accounts Receivable,

We are writing regarding invoice 5 for the amount of $15,500.00, associated with our purchase order PO-88888.

We are currently unable to process this invoice for payment as our records indicate that the corresponding goods/services have not yet been received.

Could you please investigate this on your end and provide a proof of delivery? If this invoice was issued in error, please issue a credit note to cancel the charge.

We kindly request a response within 5 business days to help us resolve this matter promptly.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,

Accounts Payable Team

This is likely a timing issue where the invoice was submitted before the receiving department could create the Goods Receipt Note (GRN).
recommended_action: Contact the PO owner or receiving department to confirm delivery and request the GRN be raised against PO-45002.
